methods.description: Divide by the nonzero base for each step down to index zero.
Compare equal powers divided by themselves with the division law to establish zero power.
Recognise a nonzero whole bracket or fractional base with zero index as1.
Distinguish a bracketed negative base from a minus sign outside the zero power.
Expand a zero base raised to a positive whole-number index.
Explain why neither permitted rule nor division by zero evaluates0^0 here.
Replace valid zero powers by1 then perform the remaining arithmetic.
Evaluate bracketed/unbracketed zero powers and a positive power of zero before ordering.
Evaluate inner zero powers or a whole nonzero power with outer index zero, then any requested arithmetic.
